notes: All three widths: single quiet column, no horizontal scroll/overflow, nothing clipped at the screen edge.
Team/match names read fully at 375px and 393px (e.g. 'Leeds United – Tottenham Hotspur', 'Borussia Dortmund – SV Elversberg') — no truncation hiding which side is playing.
Channels shown are Norwegian (Viaplay, TV 2 Play, Eliteserien TV 2, HBO Max Sport) — no foreign broadcaster (FOX/ESPN/Sky) observed.
Flags and club crests render as icons; no broken-image boxes seen.
Day headers (I DAG / I MORGEN / LØRDAG 7. NOVEMBER / ...), header and footer intact and aligned at all three widths.
Must-see accent dots used sparingly, not on every row.

At 900px the floating 'Assistent' button rests over a mid-agenda row (Sint-Truidense – Brann, UEFA Conference League) — this is the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom, not flagged. It does not occlude the last agenda row or the footer, which is the one guarantee that matters.
Live in-progress matches show an inline '0-0' score, consistent across widths.
